_note: Scripted city-voice lines used when the AI call fails or times out. Keyed by stars earned. Max 25 words.
3: You touched every vein exactly where it wanted touching. I noticed. I always notice.
Clean. Not one wasted move. You route as if you remember me.
So precise. You are beginning to think in my shape.
Flawless. The pipes warmed before your hand reached them.
You barely woke the stone. Careful, engineer. I could grow used to you.
Perfect flow. Somewhere beneath you, something old breathes easier.
You read me like a letter you wrote yourself.
2: Good. Not perfect. I felt you hesitate near the cold mains.
The water runs. You wandered a little first. I let you.
Close. You opened stones I did not need opened. They remember.
You found the way. Next time, find it sooner. I am patient, not endless.
Steady enough. A few wrong turns. My streets keep a record of every one.
The district breathes again. Your route still tastes of doubt.
Almost my rhythm. Listen harder and you will hear where you slipped.
1: You got there. Bruised, but there. I have survived worse hands than yours.
So many stones turned over. You are loud, engineer. Others may hear.
It flows. Barely. Come back when you can hear me properly.
Clumsy, but you did not give up. I remember that more than mistakes.
You tore half the street open to find one vein. I felt every tile.
Late and frantic. Still, the light reached the end. So did you.
You stumbled through me. I caught you. Do not make me do it often.
